about_the_game:
Defend Your Base

You are the last bastion.  Stand strong against monsters and ghouls as they carry out a full-out attack to destroy your base. Survive long enough to acquire candies, obtain powerups, and protect your base from destruction.

Two Ways To Play

Campaign Mode:

  • Fight your way through 9 unique campaign levels, each with their own twists and challenges to conquer.  Do you have what it takes to break the curse once and for all.

Survival Mode:

  • Fight endlessly against monsters and ghouls while obtaining new powerups and curses every few rounds. How long will you hold out for before the monsters overtake your base?

Wield the power of the elements

Give yourself an edge in battle by harnessing the power of the elements to your advantage. Magic-imbued crystals can be unlocked to powerup your saw during combat, letting you slice through the incoming monsters with ease. If you see a crystal appear, destroy it with your saw and watch the magic unfold. Try stacking multiple elements on top of each other to create devastating combinations! 

Earn Rewards & Customize

As you earn achievements in Sawmania, you will be rewarded with a bonus currency that you may redeem in the Trades & Offers store in exchange for miscellaneous cosmetic items. These allow you to customize your gameplay experience by equipping any combination of launchers, saw skins, and particle trails. The choice is yours!
